thread:
Maya Rao: quick thought — dashboards keep burying prefetch credits when routes spike. can we add a compact 'cost-lighthouse' flag per route so ops can pin routes that should surface prefetch ROI first?
Kevin Lin: +1. are we talking visibility only or changing attribution semantics too?
Maya Rao: both ideally. flag controls (1) whether prefetch credits are shown inline for that route, and (2) whether the route gets visual priority in the heatmap. default off, opt-in per product.
Sudeep Patel: attribution is the tricky bit. current amortization to the first owner in multi-model chains is misleading. propose emitting header: X-Prefetch-Owner: team/<slug> and threading it through telemetry so attribution is explicit.
Liz Chen: Console UX idea: add a tiny "prefetch ROI" sparkline next to the token-burn sparkline plus a 3-state badge (Net+, Net-, Neutral). tooltip explains attribution differences.
Kevin Lin: implementation sketch — extend internal telemetry/event with: 
```json
{
  "route_id": "teams/alpha/chat-complete",
  "cost_lighthouse": true,
  "prefetch_owner": "team/alpha",
  "prefetch_credit_tokens": 1245,
  "prefetch_savings_tokens": 987
}
```
Sudeep Patel: keep backward compatibility. if header missing, agent should infer owner best-effort and mark inferred=true. we need migration plan so billing/console doesn't flip-flop.
Maya Rao: rollout phases: ingest (accept new fields), expose (console behind feature flag), reconcile (historical recompute for last 7 days for flagged routes).
Liz Chen: UX nit — when cost_lighthouse=true show a doc link in tooltip and display sampling rate used for any recompute. also show "tokens per 1k invocations" to help PMs estimate ROI.
Kevin Lin: ops-bot note: admin API needed for toggling cost_lighthouse per route (project-admin only).
ops-bot: noted — created INF-1207 on data-ingest board "support prefetch_owner header + cost_lighthouse flag" :white_check_mark: 
Sudeep Patel: measurement: include prefetch_latency_ms if model-side probe reports it, since prefetch affects SLOs beyond token cost.
Maya Rao: agreed. add nullable prefetch_latency_ms to schema and surface as secondary column.
Kevin Lin: recompute plan: do full recompute only for routes with cost_lighthouse=true, sample 1% for others to avoid heavy load.
Liz Chen: console should show a "partial recompute" badge on periods where we sampled.
Maya Rao: action items: I'll draft API PR + console mock. Sudeep, sketch telemetry schema diff. Kevin, add admin endpoints. sync next Tue.
Sudeep Patel: will post ingestion schema diff before EOD.
Kevin Lin: tentative PR slot Wed AM.
Maya Rao: thanks — this should speed up triage and cut down on ghost-savings confusion.
